why: the two new coding-subs records hold the tier ladder, the models and the headless `amp -x` and `amp -ox` modes that compute/amp-2 only summarises; a later verify unit should relate them (same_offer_as or variant_of) so a reader sees one Amp offer, and check that the integrator does not fold the drafts into the tierless compute records
